info.title: GitHub issue search
info.description: GitHub's public issue and pull request search, keyless (10 searches a minute per address).

get.description: `items[]`: `{number, title, state, html_url, created_at, closed_at, comments, body, repository_url, labels[], milestone}`. `q` uses GitHub's search syntax: words plus qualifiers such as `org:spring-projects`, `repo:spring-projects/spring-boot`, `is:issue`, `is:open`, `in:title`.
